outcome: Metabolic acidemia in umbilical artery at delivery
finding: While repetitive FBS (≥ 3) during labors with CTG changes did not increase the risk of adverse neonatal outcomes like low Apgar score or metabolic acidemia, it was associated with a doubled risk of cesarean delivery compared to 1-2 FBS.
mod_finding: Women undergoing repetitive fetal scalp blood sampling (≥ 3) during labor with CTG changes had a doubled rate of cesarean delivery compared to those needing 1-2 samplings.
